batch.title: Independent verification and release
batch.goal: Reproduce all launch evidence in a clean context, complete human sign-offs, and pilot a restricted organization cohort.
exitCriteria: All required launch gates are evidence-complete on one immutable staging commit and a freshly migrated database.
Independent technical verification, product approval, security approval, and restricted pilot evidence are recorded with zero registry drift.

findings.title: Runtime persona kit is stale and incomplete
findings.solution: Replace it with strict current-route producer/recipient and negative tests on named staging.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Live-audit provenance is missing
findings.solution: Require source manifests and immutable evidence receipts for live database and platform claims.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

specTasks.title: Exercise backup/restore
acceptanceCriteria: Database/storage/config restoration to isolated environment meets RPO/RTO target and verifies relational/file/publication consistency.

specTasks.title: Exercise migration rollback/forward-fix
acceptanceCriteria: Representative tenant migration and failure are rehearsed; recovery maintains tenant isolation and no lost/duplicate side effects.

specTasks.title: Perform security review/penetration test
acceptanceCriteria: IDOR/RLS, privilege escalation, token/file/export, realtime, webhook, injection, race and sensitive-data findings are resolved to release policy.

specTasks.title: Run load/soak/fault tests
acceptanceCriteria: Portfolio scale, command center, publication fanout, scanning, notifications, exports and provider/database degradation meet SLO/recovery goals.

specTasks.title: Produce operational runbooks
acceptanceCriteria: Auth/context, migration, RLS, publication backlog, provider outage, ticket scan, data mismatch, compromised token, privacy/security incident and rollback have tested steps/owners.

specTasks.title: Pilot and GA checklist
acceptanceCriteria: Design partners, data migration/reconciliation, flags, support/training, monitoring window, rollback threshold, incident staffing, release notes and legacy cutoff are signed off.

specTasks.title: Delete dead/legacy code
acceptanceCriteria: Telemetry and reconciliation prove safe; old planners/routes/policies/dual writes/flags are removed and dependency/security surface is reduced.

workflows.title: Reliability, Observability, Migration, and Release Evidence

producer.outcome: Runs build, migration, security, reliability, and evidence gates on an immutable commit.

recipients.outcome: Reviews reproducible evidence and records a release decision.

command.tenantTarget: immutable commit and named staging environment

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Verification uses isolated non-production data and cannot silently skip live cases or expose secrets.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Every gate resolves from immutable evidence and contradictory claims cause NO-GO.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: events_v2, canonical tour access, and persisted plan/publication services
invariants: Legacy event identifiers are exposed only through the governed migration mapping.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

references.canonicalSource: Validated Admin registry, immutable evidence, and generated presentation views
invariants: No status is promoted by historical narrative claims.
Generated views are reproducible and never hand-edited.

launchGates.title: TypeScript typecheck passes
launchGates.acceptance: Exit code 0 under the pinned Node 20 toolchain.

launchGates.title: Production build passes
launchGates.acceptance: Production build exits 0 with the governed environment fixture.

launchGates.title: Admin automated tests pass
launchGates.acceptance: All Admin suites pass with no unexplained skips.

launchGates.title: Admin route registry passes
launchGates.acceptance: Every Admin route/method is classified and legacy debt does not grow.

launchGates.title: Service-role allowlist passes
launchGates.acceptance: No unreviewed bare service-role import remains.

launchGates.title: Migration validation passes
launchGates.acceptance: Every governed migration has safe SQL and matching evidence manifest.

launchGates.title: Zero open P0 findings
launchGates.acceptance: All P0 findings are Done with required evidence.

launchGates.title: Zero launch-blocking P1 findings
launchGates.acceptance: All P1 security, isolation, migration, and delivery findings are Done.

launchGates.title: SECURITY DEFINER inventory complete
launchGates.acceptance: Every privileged function has actor binding, pinned search path, restricted grants, tests, or an approved removal record.

launchGates.title: Repository and staging migration parity
launchGates.acceptance: Named staging schema, policies, grants, buckets, functions, and migration versions match the immutable commit.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.

launchGates.title: Admin to Worker journey passes
launchGates.acceptance: Posting through check-in and recipient acknowledgement passes without soft assertions.

launchGates.title: Admin to Artist journey passes
launchGates.acceptance: Assignment and publication reach the intended Artist surface with tenant isolation.

launchGates.title: Canonical event lifecycle passes
launchGates.acceptance: Provider ingestion, events_v2, tour assignment, publication, calendar, and Artist delivery reconcile with zero unexplained delta.

launchGates.title: Multi-organization switching and revocation pass
launchGates.acceptance: Switch, stale-tab, revocation, and cache invalidation behave consistently in UI, API, and database.

launchGates.title: Navigation, accessibility, and responsive acceptance
launchGates.acceptance: Canonical navigation, keyboard, screen-reader, phone, tablet, and desktop journeys pass.

launchGates.title: Performance and reliability acceptance
launchGates.acceptance: Query budgets, retries, idempotency, observability, and failure recovery meet approved thresholds.

launchGates.title: Final release decision recorded
launchGates.acceptance: Independent verification plus named product and security approvers record GO; otherwise release remains NO-GO.
